Thanks for your feedback. We have introduced a new booking system from 1st October to help manage patient demand for both on the day care and prebookable routine matters. This new system has significantly reduced the number of missed appointments and is supporting patients in being seen in a more timely manner - we’re now able to offer a large number of appointments to be booked that same week whilst patients were previously seeing a three week wait for a routine appointment.  

Whilst we’re confident the system is working well, we accept that this is a new way of working and there will be no doubt be tweaks and changes along the way to improve this system. If you have any feedback that might help us in improving our service please feel free to discuss with reception or ask to speak to our Practice Manager. 

Warmest regards

The Victoria Practice
